title: Adapter run configuration document v1
description: The adapter protocol v1 run-create configuration document (T97, 04.7.1-T1.2). It is assembled server-side at run create (05.2.1-T1 from 06.2.2's per-project capture flags, redaction patterns and per-kind size caps) and delivered to the adapter, which applies redaction and skips capture for a disabled kind before any byte leaves the CI runner. A capability document declaring capture_control: false may ignore this document; the run is then labelled capture_uncontrolled (04.7.1 AC7). Directions: server → adapter. Kinds are the closed 00 §7 artifact-kind list; redaction rule types are the 06.2.2 allowlist. The body is capped at 64 KiB (x-max-bytes) as a defensive transport bound — the 04.7.1 §8 16 KiB rule applies to the capability document, which the adapter sends.

kinds.description: The closed 00 §7 artifact-kind list; a kind outside it is an unknown member and is rejected here as well as by 06.1.2's kind lookup

capture_enabled.description: false = the adapter must not capture this kind at all (06.2.2 AC4); the server never receives pre-redaction bytes

max_bytes.description: Per-kind policy cap (06 artifact_kind_policy.max_bytes); 1 TiB is the schema's sanity bound, the real default is 06.1.2-T3.1's per-kind value

rule_type.description: 06.2.2 allowlist — a rule type outside it is rejected at write time (422 redaction_rule_type_unknown)
